pages.text: Basic set: 12%% less monster damage, 15%% more sign range and 25%% more sign damage. Full set: every fourth eligible cast gains a 1.2 multiplier.
Two pieces grant 40%% of the bonus, three grant 70%%, and four grant 100%% plus the full-set effect. Mix tiers freely. Official bouts suspend school bonuses. Hold Shift over a piece for details.
Sign damage: 25 / 35 / 45%%. Fourth eligible cast: +20 / 25 / 30%%. Values are for Basic, Enhanced and Mastercrafted armor. Mixed tiers use their average.

Smithing table: a netherite upgrade template and venom gland upgrade a base piece. A second template and gravebound steel fragment make it mastercrafted. Tiers increase durability and toughness. At an anvil you can transfer compatible enchantments from matching diamond or netherite armor.
